title: Mechanism 3: PKIX mutual TLS via crate-pkix (pkix-path, pkix-identity, pkix-truststore, pkix-revocation)
description: Git dep on MarkAtwood/crate-pkix at a pinned rev. RFC 5280 path validation against configured anchors with policy constraints, dNSName match per RFC 9525. Outbound: rustls client identity, replacing the socat client-cert proxy. Live with Haven (its mimi-hubd uses mTLS with a configured CA). Needs mimid-75nk.4.
notes: Haven root + client cert in tools/interop/haven/certs (verified: fingerprint matches 238223, chain OK, SAN mimi.havenmessenger.com, clientAuth, RSA). Use as the real-world test chain and Haven's anchor.
